list.name: machine
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: v.bucket, tag: "machine_id", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
list.label: Machine

targets.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_c")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "temperature_c")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "vibration_rms_g")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "vibration_rms_g")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pressure_psi")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "pressure_psi")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "health_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> yield(name: "health_score")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "health_score")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id"])
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "health_score")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "cycle_total")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id"])
  |> last()
  |> yield(name: "cycle_total")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "machine_metrics")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => contains(value: r.machine_id, set: ${machine:json}))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature_c" or r._field == "vibration_rms_g" or r._field == "health_score" or r._field == "alert")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group(columns: ["machine_id"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "machine_id", "run_state", "temperature_c", "vibration_rms_g", "health_score", "alert"])
